propositions: The autouse repository-isolation guard's head() probe times out at a fixed five-second watchdog during full-suite concurrent load despite completing successfully under sequential and controlled-concurrency conditions.
The five-second watchdog calibration was based on unloaded probe latency (median 0.0143s, max 0.0610s) and does not account for concurrent workload behavior.
Real probe latency under 18-process concurrency reaches p99 2.08s and max 3.30s, but never exceeds five seconds in the instrumented investigation run.
Host oversubscription (load avg p50 76.4, max 170; process count max 771; Python/pytest p50 1,288% CPU) correlates with slow probes and identifies scheduler/filesystem starvation as the mechanism.
The exact failure nodes pass when run serially, and recorded runtime evidence rules out PATH contamination, Git-environment inheritance, and test-local state as causes.
